title: Challenge, credential and receipt anatomy
caption: What each of the three messages carries. The challenge id binds every parameter except description, the credential echoes the challenge, and the receipt appears only on success. The HMAC slot order follows the repository text at commit 50309c8, which mppx implements; the posted -01 differs only when header is set.
alt: Three stacked boxes. Challenge in WWW-Authenticate: Payment with status 402: required id, realm, method, intent and request; optional digest, expires, description, header and opaque; the recommended id is HMAC-SHA256 over realm, method, intent, request, expires, digest and opaque joined by pipes, with empty slots for absent values and description never bound. A note says that when header is set, the repository text after PR 362 (2026-09-21) and mppx put its slot before opaque, while the posted -01 (2026-09-09) appends it after opaque. Credential in Authorization: Payment as base64url: challenge echo, optional payer DID source, method payload, sent in Payment-Authorization when the challenge set header. Receipt in Payment-Receipt, 2xx only: status success, method, timestamp and reference, with method extras such as subscriptionId, challengeId and channelId.

sourceOfTruth.label: Core draft-httpauth-payment-01, repository text at commit 50309c8 (HMAC slot order from PR 362), sections on challenge, credentials and receipt
